test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following microfinance institutions was established in India at the time of independence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rural Cooperatives**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rural Cooperatives** were established in India around the time of Indian independence, aiming to pool the resources of impoverished individuals and provide them with financial services.
 
• The cooperative movement in India traces back to 1904 with the enactment of the Cooperative Credit Societies Act.
 
• This legislation followed the recommendations of the Indian Famine Commission of 1901, which advised the government to form a committee to assess the potential introduction of cooperative societies in India.
 
• Implemented as a State policy, the cooperative movement in India experienced diverse phases of progress and setbacks during the pre-independence period.
 
• Cooperatives play a significant role in alleviating poverty by fostering economic opportunities and promoting a fair distribution of benefits. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **A Joint Liability Group (JLG) **is an informal association of 4–10 individuals who join forces to access bank loans collectively. 
 
• **Self-help groups** are informal associations formed by individuals with shared interests or challenges. 
 
• **The Grameen Bank model** is a pioneering microfinance approach designed to uplift the extreme poor by providing them with access to financial services.
